title: Fibonacci
caption:
Why do so many traders care about 61.8%?

A Fibonacci retracement is drawn from a swing low to a swing high, marking 23.6, 38.2, 50 and 61.8% of the move. When price pulls back, traders watch those levels for a pause.

They're not magic. They work best alongside other support, and price misses them all the time.

Fibonacci is one of the drawing tools on Meme Street. Practise at memestreet.net

narration: Why do so many traders care about sixty one point eight percent? A Fibonacci retracement is drawn from a swing low to a swing high. It marks levels at twenty three point six, thirty eight point two, fifty and sixty one point eight percent of the move. When price pulls back, traders watch those levels for a place where it might pause. This time, it held near sixty one point eight percent, and buyers stepped back in. But they aren't magic. They work best when they line up with other support, and price misses them all the time. Fibonacci is one of the drawing tools on Meme Street's charts. Practise at memestreet.net.
